facts.fact: The Ministry of Digital Transition (MTNRA) brochure says it launched the JobIntech programme (pilot June 2023, scale-up phase June 2024) and plans to scale up 3-6 month upskilling and reskilling bootcamps and create regional coding schools with public and private partners.
The MTNRA brochure states that 1000 talents had been trained through the JobIntech programme by the end of August 2024.
